allowed_actions: replay the exact P3L source and fixed operators
count frozen failure masks by frame distance and input-state bins
report association rather than physical causation
forbidden_actions: change any P3L source, decode, operator, parameter, threshold or gate
generate or inspect aesthetic visual candidates
open a boundary-mode, strength or profile rescue from attribution alone
claim the diagnosed association is calibrated physical causation

branch_rule.frame-boundary-associated: retain boundary handling as the leading mechanism hypothesis; any challenger requires a separately preregistered physical aperture contract and cannot reopen P3L
branch_rule.other: close mechanism attribution at the strongest observed association and move to a distinct algorithm or data leaf

claim_ceiling: read-only spatial association diagnosis of a closed generic scene-linear backing-return candidate; no visual, causal, stock, calibration or product claim
